LESSON: FORCE AND ITS EFFECT

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY
Strand: Force and Energy
Topic 3.1: Force and its Effect

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Force and its Effect. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Force and its Effect
2. Practise Force and its Effect at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Force and its Effect

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Force and its Effect
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Force and its Effect. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Force and its Effect at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Force and its Effect at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Force and its Effect
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Force and its Effect. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Force and its Effect using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Force and its Effect in the examples.
2. Explain Force and its Effect to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Force and its Effect.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Force and its Effect using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Force and its Effect important for a Grade 4 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Force and its Effect
2. Practise Force and its Effect at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Force and its Effect

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
